instruction: In Thunderbird, establish local folders named NEWSLETTERS and RECEIPTS.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating two local folders (NEWSLETTERS and RECEIPTS) in Thunderbird. The evaluator reuses the existing check_list metric function to verify that both the folder files and .msf index files exist for both folders using regex patterns.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly captures state by running 'ls -R' on Thunderbird's Local Folders directory in postconfig
Getter logic (get_cache_file) correctly retrieves the cached ls output
Metric logic (check_list) correctly uses regex patterns to verify both .msf files and directories exist
Complete coverage: verifies both NEWSLETTERS and RECEIPTS folders, checking both the directory and .msf index file for each
Regex patterns are semantically correct: \bNEWSLETTERS\.msf\b matches the index file, \bNEWSLETTERS/?(?!\.msf) matches the directory name
Evaluator can successfully verify task completion at runtime
